# Hockia (inhockia.com)

> Hockia is the field hockey network for players, coaches, clubs, umpires and brands. It is free to join and to use.

Canonical name: Hockia (inhockia.com). Hockia is about field hockey (the sport played on grass or turf with a stick and a ball), not ice hockey.

## What people do on Hockia

- Players and coaches create a profile, find open roles at clubs worldwide and apply directly.
- Clubs publish open roles for players and coaches and review the applications they receive.
- Umpires and brands have their own profiles and take part in the same community.
- Anyone can browse the world directory of field hockey clubs and leagues by country.

## Cost

Hockia is free for players, coaches, clubs, umpires and brands.

## Key pages

- [Open field hockey roles for players and coaches](https://inhockia.com/opportunities): every open role, with club, city and country.
- [Open field hockey roles in Australia](https://inhockia.com/opportunities/in/australia): open roles by country, at /opportunities/in/ followed by the country name (for example new-zealand). A country has a page while it has open roles.
- [World directory of field hockey clubs and leagues](https://inhockia.com/world): clubs by country, region and league.
- [Community](https://inhockia.com/community): players, coaches, clubs and umpires on Hockia.
- [Join Hockia](https://inhockia.com/signup): create a free profile.
- [About Hockia](https://inhockia.com/about): what Hockia is, who it is for and who runs it.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://inhockia.com/faq): how clubs recruit, how to apply for a role and which countries are covered.
- [Developers](https://inhockia.com/developers): the public API for open roles and structured data.
- [Sitemap](https://inhockia.com/api/sitemap.xml)
